observations.body: Saul proclaims in Damascus and escapes. He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus. but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

payload.posture: Read Acts 9:19–25 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states saul proclaims in Damascus and escapes. He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus. but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
